title: Remove flag names the open internal work orders that stay internal
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in Estimate.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 2, for internal customer A, in status Approved.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page.
  2. Click Edit Customer on customer A's page.
  3. Untick the "Internal customer" checkbox.
  4. Click "Remove flag".
  5. Click Save.
  6. Open work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The header shows the "Internal" badge.

Step 2:

  • "Internal customer" is ticked.

Step 3:

  • A window opens titled "Remove the Internal flag from [customer A's name]?"
  • Its text reads "2 open internal work orders for [customer A's name] stay internal and close without an invoice. New work orders for [customer A's name] will be billable."

Step 4:

  • The window closes and "Internal customer" is unticked.

Step 5:

  • The Edit Customer window closes and the header no longer shows the "Internal" badge.

Step 6:

  • Work order 1 still shows the "Internal" badge next to its status.
  • Its lines still show no prices.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R6: “Unticking the "Internal customer" checkbox on Edit Customer opens the dialog of S1-R12 before the dialog is saved; on confirmation Save clears the flag. Cancel leaves the checkbox ticked.”
  • S1-R12: “Removing the flag (unticking the checkbox on Edit Customer, S1-R6) opens the dialog "Remove the Internal flag from [customer]?" with the body "[n] open internal work orders for [customer] stay internal and close without an invoice. New work orders for [customer] will be billable." with the buttons Cancel and "Remove flag" (with no open internal work orders the first sentence is omitted). Confirming clears the flag; open internal work orders keep their classification and badge, close as internal, and can be made billable by changing their customer.”
  • S1-N5: “If a flagged customer has open internal work orders, removing the flag is not refused; the dialog of S1-R12 states what happens to them. Closed and Declined work orders are not counted in [n].”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Flag removed | "Remove the Internal flag from [customer]?" with "[n] open internal work orders for [customer] stay internal and close without an invoice. New work orders for [customer] will be billable." | Confirmation dialog, Cancel / Remove flag”
  • Key Decisions: “Flagging a customer offers to make its open billable work orders internal; removing the flag is free and leaves open internal work orders internal.”
